_comment: REQ item 246 h (LT1 phase 2a): shared cases of seats per stretch. A leg has `points` route places (0 = where it starts, points-1 = where it ends) and points-1 stretches between them; a rider takes seats on the stretches from `board` up to (not including) `alight` (null = the leg's start / end; out of range is clamped; board >= alight = the whole leg, the safe reading). Run by src/solver/__tests__/stretchLoads.test.ts (TS stretchLoads/fitsAlong) and scripts/test-stretch-load-parity.mjs (SQL public._stretch_loads). `loads` = [adults, childSeats, boosters] per stretch; `fits` = some configuration of `configs` takes every stretch.

cases.name: no riders: every stretch is empty
whole-leg riders only = the plain per-leg sum on every stretch
kids get off at school, a passenger boards after: 5 seats carry 7 people
the busiest stretch decides: one stretch over the car refuses
alighting where another boards frees the seat (half-open stretches)
each stretch may use a different seat configuration
board at or after alight, or out of range: the whole leg (safe)
a two-point leg has one stretch
